description: This file declares functions for serializing and deserializing JSON data with protection via TpmResourceManager, specifically for writing to and reading from files in a secure environment.

methods.name: WriteProtectedJsonToFile
methods.description: Serializes a Json::Value to a file with protection managed by TpmResourceManager.

methods.name: ReadProtectedJsonFromFile
methods.description: Deserializes a Json::Value from a file with protection managed by TpmResourceManager.
